name: MNG Web Design System
description: How the token files stack (theme -> sub-theme -> site). Pick one context of the "brand" modifier: a theme, a sub-theme or a publication domain. Generated by scripts/build-tokens/make-tokens.py.

the-baltimore-sun.name: The Baltimore Sun
the-baltimore-sun.note: Uses its documented Figma styles as is. No production comparison is tracked.

21c-michigan-sites-combined.name: 21C Michigan Sites (Combined)
21c-michigan-sites-combined.loads: modernearthy.css + Customizer override (div#page), identical on all 4 sites

daily-herald.name: Daily Herald
daily-herald.note: New palette 2026-10-15 (Karl): primary #0072b4 is given; light, lighter, dark and darker are extrapolated with the OKLCH steps of the other blue Modern Earthy sub-themes (Boston Herald, Morning Call) and St. Paul Pioneer Press; secondary and tertiary match Boston Herald and Morning Call; near-black, white and nav-text are the Modern Earthy defaults. Not in the Figma Colors collection (20-mode limit); documented on the Color Pallets page. Daily Herald isn't on MNG themes in production yet (Everyware, verified 2026-09-24), so there is no production audit.

nepa-pmp.name: NEPA-PMP
nepa-pmp.loads: modernearthy.css + color override on body: site-pmp style.min.css (PMP sites) or each NEPA site's own site plugin (site-citizensvoice, site-thetimes-tribune, site-wcexaminer, site-republicanherald, site-standardspeaker), identical values
nepa-pmp.note: One color sub-theme for two groups: the 19 PMP sites (shared site-pmp stylesheet) and the 5 NEPA sites (each site's own plugin stylesheet). Verified live 2026-10-01: NEPA sets the same six variables on body with identical values, and renders the same type as PMP.

chicago-tribune.name: Chicago Tribune
chicago-tribune.loads: measuredvibrant.css (Measured Vibrant values; own Figma mode)
chicago-tribune.note: No style guide of its own; audited under Measured Vibrant, whose production callouts apply.

hartford-courant.name: Hartford Courant
hartford-courant.note: Verified live 2026-09-25: loads measuredvibrant.css + site-tribune style.min.css, with a div#page Customizer override (primary, light and dark all #2b7ea5). Production matches the Figma production column.

endless-tributes.name: Endless Tributes
endless-tributes.loads: obituaries pages, identical on every site
endless-tributes.note: Shared obituaries palette. Production gaps are logged in production-vs-design-differences.md entry 11.
endless-tributes.typography: Colors only. Obituary pages follow the site's theme fonts (font.theme.*) like the rest of the site (Karl, 2026-10-14). Load this file after the site's theme file.

sonomamag.com.note: Not on MNG WordPress themes (verified 2026-09-24): no MNG theme tokens.
